newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 8.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast government and U.N. refugee agency start steps to help Liberian refugees who want to return home for elections next month marking end of civil war in their country.
- Energy-saving measures in public buildings could save Ivorian government three billion CFA annually if properly implemented.
- Ivorian Refining Company to be privatised before the end of this year, Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan tells staff during visit to the Abidjan-based facility.
- Transporters kick against plan by government to introduce speed limiters in public transport vehicles.
- Training session opens in Abidjan for Internet web site developers from French-speaking West African states.
- Examinations kick off peacefully at Ivorianm university campuses after a series of strikes and clashes between students and police threatened them.
